note: Meta Omnilingual ASR LLM-1B fine-tuned on our Common Voice Gujari split (train 9,041 clips, 3 speakers), scored with the same scorer as the Whisper and zero-shot runs on the 623 official test clips. The checkpoint was chosen by dev word error (475 clips, scored by us); the test set was scored once, for that checkpoint. One run, one seed. Zero-shot LLM-1B for comparison: 13.37% word error (data/asr/results_omniasr_zero-shot_2026-11-25.json). Meta may have trained on these public clips; not checked.
config_yaml:
model:
  name: "omniASR_LLM_1B"
dataset:
  name: "gojri_cv_gju26"
  train_split: "train"
  valid_split: null
  storage_mode: "MIXTURE_PARQUET"
  task_mode: "ASR"
  mixture_parquet_storage_config:
    dataset_summary_path: "/opt/ml/input/data/data/language_distribution_0.tsv"
    beta_corpus: 0.5
    beta_language: 0.5
  asr_task_config:
    min_audio_len: 8000
    max_audio_len: 320000
    max_num_elements: 320000
    batch_shuffle_window: 1
    normalize_audio: true
    example_shuffle_window: 1
tokenizer:
  name: "omniASR_tokenizer_v1"
optimizer:
  config:
    lr: 5e-05
trainer:
  data_parallelism: "fsdp"
  fsdp:
    granularity: "stack"
    version: "v1"
    fp32_reduce: false
  freeze_encoder_for_n_steps: 0
  mixed_precision:
    dtype: "torch.bfloat16"
  grad_accumulation:
    num_batches: 4
regime:
  num_steps: 400
  score_metric: null
  checkpoint_every_n_steps: 80
  publish_metrics_every_n_steps: 10
  save_model_only: true

training.loss_label_note: fairseq2 logs the training loss under the name 'CTC Loss' even for the LLM model
